title: Winners and losers from the Denver Broncos’ 31-10 blowout loss to the Kansas City Chiefs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Winners and losers from the Denver Broncos’ 31-10 blowout loss to the Kansas City Chiefs
sources.description: What an ugly showing. There are no winners. We are talking all losers tonight, and nobody is safe. The Broncos played awful on both sides of the ball and were embarrassed on the national stage vs. their divisional rivals. Blown out and looked awful while doing it. Super Bowl caliber team?
